main.description: An athlete hid a comment on one of their activities: it leaves the activity's comment count for everyone and its comment list for everyone but the athlete and the commenter. Only a hide by the athlete whose activity the comment is on counts. It is stored where the athlete's like on that activity would be: their repo when the activity is public, else their app.activitytracker.space.athlete interactions space. Its rkey is the first 20 bytes of SHA-256 over the comment's AT-URI, lowercase base32 without padding, so an athlete has at most one hide per comment; the AppView ignores a hide stored under any other rkey. Deleting it unhides the comment.
